# TeleCrypt.io Storage CLI

The sole public authority for current TeleCrypt project facts, architecture, responsibilities,
principles, limits, and user-visible behavior is https://telecrypt.io/llms.txt.

Repository-specific Storage CLI usage, command and recovery reference, development instructions,
and release procedures remain in [CLI.md](./CLI.md), [README.md](./README.md), and
[RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md).
